caption: The drawing consists of five horizontal bands, each featuring a distinct lace or embroidery pattern rendered in fine, gray lines on a plain, off-white or beige background. The topmost band shows a flowing, undulating motif with intertwined loops and pointed ends. The second band from the top contains a repeating pattern of semi-circular or scalloped shapes, each decorated with intricate internal details and a mesh-like fill. The third band features a row of oval shapes closely spaced and bordered above and below with smaller, repeated geometric forms. The fourth band presents a small-scale, dense, and regular repeating zigzag pattern above a tightly meshed foundation. The fifth and bottom-most band has a series of contiguous diamond shapes sitting over a mesh, each diamond compartmentalized into sections and internally decorated with dots or tiny circles. All five bands are centrally aligned on the page with ample blank space surrounding them.
title: Lace Edging
